senses.gloss: (b. h.) to split; to dig, till; to cut out.
units: Ex. R. s. 27 על מנת לפוֹלְחָהּ will you take this field with the condition that you will till it?; a. e.—2) to work for, serve, v. פּוֹלֵחַ.—3) to worship.

<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 1:4">Tosef. Ab. Zar. I, 4</cite> <he>אינו אסור אלא לפוֹלְחִין בלבד</he> it is forbidden to deal with those only who worship (on the Calendæ), contrad. to <he>עושין</he> who observe it as a holiday; (<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 8a">Ab. Zar. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>לעובריה</he>; Y. ib. I, 39ᶜ top <he>לפלחין בה</he>, Chald.).
